headline: Wilmington's draws now outnumber their wins
dek: Wilmington's draw with Dominican is their fourth of the season, beside two wins and three defeats. They have scored ten goals and conceded sixteen across those matches, and have not won since early September.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Georgian Court's nineteen goals are more than Dominican and Holy Family have scored between them, yet they have conceded fifteen: the conference's scoring is concentrated in one side, and its defending is not.

wire.line: Wilmington have drawn more matches than they have won or lost, and no other side in the conference has drawn as many.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dominican have scored four goals and conceded fourteen this season; the draw at Wilmington leaves them with one win, two draws and five defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Georgian Court's home match against Felician has passed its date without a published result, the only match in the conference to have done so; no played match is missing its score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Post have won four, drawn two and lost two, scoring eleven goals and conceding eight.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jefferson's six defeats remain the most in the conference, beside one win and no draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bruno Mestres has made 53 saves for Holy Family and conceded fifteen, a save percentage of .779.

last_match.line: Wilmington have not won since early September; Dominican's only win of the season came against Jefferson.

next_match.line: Chestnut Hill have lost both their conference matches; Georgian Court beat Post in their conference opener.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
